sys_script.description:
Send telework agreement information to unit 4 PBI #156429 - leaving inactive for now since we're not ready for prime time for best practices, see https://support.servicenow.com/kb?id=kb_article_view&sysparm_article=KB0694711
After discussing with business, we decided that we would send the approved agreements regularly in batch instead of right away. So we're using a flow instead. Doing it with scheduled flow allows: -infinite retries without duplicating logic or schema modification -sending an error notification with all the issues in 1 email instead of 1 per agreement
